title: Numbers: 1 to 1000
grammarTitle: Числа от 1 до 1000 — как читать и писать по-английски
grammarNote:
Числа в английском языке строятся по чёткой системе. Если понять логику, любое число от 1 до 1,000 читается легко.

🔢 ЧИСЛА 1–12 (нужно запомнить наизусть):
one · two · three · four · five · six · seven · eight · nine · ten · eleven · twelve

Эти числа нельзя вывести из правил — только запомнить!

🔢 ЧИСЛА 13–19 (основа + -teen):
three → thir-TEEN · four → four-TEEN · five → fif-TEEN · six → six-TEEN
seven → seven-TEEN · eight → eigh-TEEN · nine → nine-TEEN

⚠️ ВНИМАНИЕ — исключения в написании:
• thirteen (не "threteen") — thir-teen
• fifteen (не "fiveteen") — fif-teen (five → fif!)
• eighteen (не "eightten") — eigh-teen (одна t, не две!)

🔢 ДЕСЯТКИ 20–90 (основа + -ty):
20 = twenty · 30 = thirty · 40 = FORTY · 50 = fifty
60 = sixty · 70 = seventy · 80 = eighty · 90 = ninety

⚠️ САМЫЕ ЧАСТЫЕ ОШИБКИ студентов:
❌ "fourty" → ✅ FORTY (нет буквы u! four → forty, u выпадает)
❌ "ninty" → ✅ NINETY (девяносто: nine → ninety, e не выпадает)
❌ "fivety" → ✅ FIFTY (пятьдесят: five → fifty, v → f!)

🔢 СОСТАВНЫЕ ЧИСЛА 21–99 (десятки + дефис + единицы):
21 = twenty-ONE · 35 = thirty-FIVE · 47 = forty-SEVEN
63 = sixty-THREE · 99 = ninety-NINE

📌 ПРАВИЛО: между десятками и единицами всегда ставится ДЕФИС (-):
✅ "twenty-five" (не "twenty five" и не "twentyfive")

🔢 СОТНИ 100–900:
100 = a hundred / one hundred
200 = two hundred · 300 = three hundred · 500 = five hundred

📌 После "hundred" НЕТ буквы s даже во множественном числе!
❌ "three hundreds" → ✅ "three hundred"

🔢 ЧИСЛА 101–999 (сотни + and + остаток):
101 = one hundred AND one
215 = two hundred AND fifteen
350 = three hundred AND fifty
768 = seven hundred AND sixty-eight

📌 "AND" — обязательно! Оно соединяет сотни с остатком:
"two hundred" + AND + "fifty-three" = "two hundred and fifty-three"

🔢 ТЫСЯЧА:
1,000 = one thousand / a thousand
1,500 = one thousand five hundred (или: fifteen hundred)
2,750 = two thousand seven hundred and fifty
15,000 = fifteen thousand (как в бюджете Nursultan!)

💡 КАК ЧИТАТЬ ЦЕНЫ В ТЕНГЕ:
800T = "eight hundred tenge"
1,800T = "one thousand eight hundred tenge"
2,500T = "two thousand five hundred tenge"
15,000T = "fifteen thousand tenge"
22,770T = "twenty-two thousand seven hundred and seventy tenge"

grammarTable.subject: ⚠️ Ловушки
grammarTable.example: ❌ fourty → ✅ forty · ❌ ninty → ✅ ninety · ❌ fiveteen → ✅ fifteen · ❌ "three hundreds" → ✅ "three hundred"

rows.example: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten — фундамент всей системы чисел
eleven (11), twelve (12) — не "oneteen", не "twoteen"! Только так.
thir-TEEN (не "threeteen") · four-TEEN ✅ · fif-TEEN (не "fiveteen" — v→f!) · six-TEEN ✅
six-TEEN · seven-TEEN · eigh-TEEN (одна t!) · nine-TEEN
"thirTEEN" (13) = ударение на конец: /θɜːˈtiːn/ vs "THIRty" (30) = ударение в начале: /ˈθɜːti/. На слух различай по ударению!
"fifTEEN" (15) /fɪfˈtiːn/ vs "FIFty" (50) /ˈfɪfti/. Оба от five → fif. Следи за ударением при чтении вслух.
twenty = 20 · thirty = 30 · forty = 40 · fifty = 50 · sixty = 60 · seventy = 70 · eighty = 80 · ninety = 90
❌ "fourty" — НЕПРАВИЛЬНО. ✅ "FORTY" — правильно. Буква u выпадает: four → forty. Запомни раз и навсегда!
❌ "ninty" — НЕПРАВИЛЬНО. ✅ "NINETY" — правильно. nine → ninety, буква e сохраняется.
21 = twenty-ONE · 35 = thirty-FIVE · 47 = forty-SEVEN · 58 = fifty-EIGHT · 99 = ninety-NINE
❌ "twenty five" (без дефиса) → ✅ "twenty-five" · ❌ "fortyseven" (слитно) → ✅ "forty-seven"
"The book costs ONE thousand EIGHT hundred tenge." · "I have THREE thousand FIVE hundred tenge left." · "FIFTEEN thousand tenge budget."
Оба варианта правильны. "a hundred" — разговорный; "one hundred" — формальный/точный. Нет разницы по смыслу.
❌ "three hundreds people" → ✅ "three hundred people" · ❌ "five hundreds tenge" → ✅ "five hundred tenge"
115 = one hundred AND fifteen · 250 = two hundred AND fifty · 307 = three hundred AND seven
Если после hundred идут ровные сотни — AND не нужен: "five hundred" ✅. AND нужен только если есть остаток меньше 100.
"eight hundred (800T) tenge" · "eight hundred and fifty (850T) tenge" · "two thousand five hundred (2,500T) tenge"
450 = four hundred and fifty · 762 = seven hundred and sixty-two · 999 = nine hundred and ninety-nine

rows.example: В эссе: "I spent TWO THOUSAND FIVE HUNDRED tenge on a phone case." ✅ В математике: используй цифры (2,500). В рассказе — слова!

grammarTip:
Четыре уровня — и любое число от 1 до 1,000 правильно:

① Знай базу наизусть (1–20):
   one, two, three... twelve, thirteen, fourteen, fifteen...
   Особо запомни: FIFTEEN (не fiveteen), EIGHTEEN (не eightten)

② Десятки — запомни ловушки:
   twenty · thirty · FORTY (не fourty!) · fifty
   sixty · seventy · eighty · NINETY (не ninty!)

③ Составные — дефис обязателен:
   twenty-ONE · forty-SEVEN · ninety-NINE
   Никогда: "twenty one" или "fortyseven"

④ Сотни — AND обязателен:
   two hundred AND fifteen (115)
   seven hundred AND sixty-eight (768)
   Исключение: ровные сотни без AND: "three hundred" ✅

💡 Запомни через бюджет Nursultan:
   15,000 = fifteen thousand tenge
   2,500 = two thousand five hundred tenge
   1,800 = one thousand eight hundred tenge
   3,550 = three thousand five hundred and fifty tenge (осталось!)

exercises.text: Choose the correct spelling of the number 40.
exercises.hint: 40 = FORTY — буква u выпадает! four → forty. ✅ Это самая частая ошибка в английском. Запомни раз и навсегда: F-O-R-T-Y.

exercises.text: Nursultan's budget was 15,000 tenge — write this in English words.
exercises.hint: 15,000 = FIFTEEN THOUSAND. 15 = fifteen (пятнадцать). 1,000 = thousand. Together: fifteen thousand. ✅

exercises.text: "Thirteen" (13) and "thirty" (30) are spelled differently but sound almost the same in English.
exercises.hint: Yes — they sound similar! thirTEEN /θɜːˈtiːn/ (ударение на конец) vs THIRty /ˈθɜːti/ (ударение в начале). Listen carefully to the stress when speaking!

exercises.instruction: How do you say this number in English?
exercises.text: How do you say the price 2,550 tenge in English?
opts: two thousand five hundred fifty tenge
two thousands five hundreds fifty tenge
two thousand five hundred and fifty tenge
exercises.correct: two thousand five hundred and fifty tenge
exercises.hint: 2,550 = two thousand + five hundred + AND + fifty. AND connects hundreds to the remainder. No -s on "thousand" or "hundred"! ✅

exercises.text: The scarf cost 4,200 tenge — write this in English words.
exercises.hint: 4,200 = FOUR THOUSAND TWO HUNDRED. No "and" needed here — 200 is an exact hundred with no remainder after it. ✅

opts: I have three hundreds tenge left.
The shop has two hundreds of different cases.
I found a book for three hundred tenge.
She spent five hundreds tenge at the market.
exercises.correct: I found a book for three hundred tenge.
exercises.hint: HUNDRED is always singular after a number! ❌ "three hundreds" → ✅ "three hundred". It never takes -s when used with a number before it.

exercises.text: Write the number 99 in English words.
exercises.hint: 99 = NINETY (не "ninty"!) + дефис + NINE = ninety-nine. ✅ Запомни: ninety сохраняет букву e из nine.

exercises.text: The number 215 is correctly written in words as "two hundred fifteen" (without "and").
exercises.hint: In British English (used at WKU), AND is required: "two hundred AND fifteen." ✅ "Two hundred fifteen" is American English. In your lessons, always use AND.
